title: The Endocrine System and Blood Glucose Control

flashcard_questions.q: A system of glands that secrete hormones directly into the bloodstream to regulate body functions.
Chemical messengers produced by glands and carried in the blood to target organs, where they trigger a response.
The specific organ or tissue that a hormone acts on to produce a response.

flashcard_questions.a: A pea-sized gland at the base of the brain that secretes hormones controlling other glands — often called the master gland.
A hormone produced by the thyroid gland that controls the metabolic rate — how quickly the body uses energy.
